newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai launches PC version of Tamagotchi.
newsitem.headline: Bandai launches PC version of Tamagotchi.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it has launched a CD-ROM version of its popular "Tamagotchi" virtual pet toy.
A Bandai spokeswoman said the CD-ROM runs on Windows 95, and that the company plans to introduce another CD-ROM version for use on Macintosh computers next month.
Earlier this month, the company launched a Tamagotchi version that can be played on the displays of Personal Handyphone System (PHS) cell phones.
The Japan-developed PHS cellphone is cheaper than a conventional portable phone and is very popular among Japanese schoolgirls.
Bandai said earlier that by the end of this month it expects to have sold 10 million of the original pocket game versions of Tamagotchi.

Bandai has had difficulty keeping up with demand for what has become Japan's hottest toy in 1997. Tamagotchi features a chicken-like figure on a liquid-crystal display that is cared for by pressing buttons.
The toy first went on sale in November 1996.
